verdict.rationale: Motion's docs say you can build a meeting template for every scenario (client calls, sales demos, and so on), each with its own duration, pre-meeting questions and reminders. They also cover customizing meeting names and location details, and adding survey questions that collect details before the meeting. This covers most of the multi-event-type story, though the evidence is marketing copy only. Missing for 10: documented confirmation rules (e.g. manual approval or confirmation settings per event type), and hands-on or independent corroboration of per-template location and question configuration.
